hero.heading: Our Story: Nurturing Nature in Abbotsford
hero.subheading: Learn about the passion, people, and principles that make Everbloom Nurseries a cornerstone of the Fraser Valley gardening community.

sections.body: Everbloom Nurseries Ltd. began with a simple vision: to share the joy of gardening with our community. Founded over two decades ago right here in Abbotsford, we started as a small, family-owned venture dedicated to growing resilient, beautiful plants suited for our unique climate. Over the years, we've blossomed, expanding our offerings and expertise, but our core commitment to quality, community, and horticultural excellence remains unchanged. We believe that a thriving garden contributes to a thriving life.

sections.body: The Fraser Valley's unique climate offers both opportunities and challenges for gardeners. Our resources are specifically curated to help you navigate local soil conditions, weather patterns, and plant hardiness zones. From understanding frost dates to selecting drought-tolerant species, we provide localized insights to ensure your garden thrives. Check back regularly for updates and new guides focusing on regional gardening topics.
